edit.description: The ignore-source policy — `hidden(false)`, `parents(false)`, `ignore(false)`, `git_global(false)`, `require_git(false)`, and the git-only `git_ignore`/`git_exclude` pair — is spelled inside `discoverable_paths` (the `WalkBuilder` at ~556) and nowhere nameable. Lift it to one `pub(crate)` constructor returning a configured `WalkBuilder` for a root and a git-ignore flavor flag; `discoverable_paths` builds from it and keeps what is genuinely its own: the `WALKS` increment, `filter_entry` (`.git`, `crate::WORKSPACE_DIR`, `is_governed_root` at depth > 0), and the per-flavor cache. Its 20-line doc comment stays the policy's rationale, now owned by the constructor.

`claude_entries` (~147-172) hand-restates the same seven flags on its own `WalkBuilder` for the unclaimed-entry scan, and its doc comment claims the two agree ('Honors the repository's ignore rules ... exactly as harness discovery does ([`crate::import`])') with nothing holding the claim. Build from the new constructor, keeping `max_depth(Some(1))` — the scan is the direct children of `<root>/.claude`, not a tree walk. Correct the overclaim: the ignore-source policy is now shared by construction, while the whole-tree walk's three `filter_entry` fences are NOT applied here — declare that divergence and why it is the right depth (a depth-1 scan of `.claude/` meets none of the three), per engineering.md, 'The fix lands at the mechanism'. Drops the module's own `use ignore::WalkBuilder` if the constructor returns a built walker. The in-module tests gain the policy pin beside `a_gitignored_stray_under_claude_never_fires` (~525).

summary: The ignore-honoring walk's source policy is spelled twice — in import's discovery walk and again in the coverage note's stray scan — and a comment claims they agree.

tests.asserts: Beside the existing gitignored-stray test: a stray named by a `.ignore` file (ripgrep's own source, which the policy keeps OFF) still fires `coverage.unclaimed-entry`, and a `.gitignore`-named one still does not — the two halves that distinguish this policy from `ignore`'s defaults, now asserted on the shared constructor's output.
The existing run-level flavor pin (`a_full_check_run_walks_...`, walks == 2) is unchanged: the consolidation adds and removes no walk, so the number is the same before and after.

acceptance: `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` green, with the ignore-source policy configured at exactly one site and the new policy pin passing.
notes: A pure consolidation: no walk is added or removed and no diagnostic changes, so no test fails on the pre-fix tree — the regression guard is structural (one home, one spelling), stated here rather than faked as a would-have-caught pin (engineering.md, 'A fix ships the test that would have caught it' — the named exception). The policy pin is forward-looking: it fails the moment either consumer's ignore sources drift. scoped at d8dafbae
